name: Vivmark Residential

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Logo of Vivmark Residential.png, 1105x333 px)

description: Vivmark Residential is the new name of Equity Residential after its merger of equals with AvalonBay Communities, completed Aug 17, 2026 (each AvalonBay share became 2.793 Equity Residential shares; the stock trades as VMRK from Aug 18, 2026). The combined company owns and runs over 180,000 rental apartments (AvalonBay 99,072 homes in 322 communities plus Equity Residential 85,520 units in 312 properties at announcement) with 10,000+ under construction. All figures below are legacy Equity Residential only, because the latest 10-K (FY2025) and 10-Q (Q2 2026) pre-date the merger. Legacy EQR earns almost all income as monthly rent from apartments in coastal markets (Southern California, San Francisco, Washington DC, New York, Boston, Seattle) plus Atlanta, Denver, Dallas and Austin; residential is over 96% of revenue and retail and parking at the buildings is the rest.

businessLines.description: 258 properties, 69,120 apartment units at Dec 31, 2025, legacy EQR.

businessLines.name: Expansion markets (Atlanta, Denver, Dallas/Ft. Worth, Austin)
businessLines.how: Same monthly-rent model at lower rents ($2,002 average) in faster-growing metros, which adds diversification.
businessLines.description: 54 properties, 16,070 apartment units at Dec 31, 2025, legacy EQR.
